Generated tobj.c uses GX declarations resolved by the actual Emscripten preprocessor to .deps/aurora/include/dolphin/gx/GXFrameBuffer.h. Its compiled object has undefined GXSetTexCopySrc, GXSetTexCopyDst, GXCopyTex, GXPixModeSync, and GXInvalidateTexAll; the gameplay_menu_browser link edge includes .deps/aurora/libaurora_gx.a, whose GXFrameBuffer.cpp, GXManage.cpp, and GXTexture.cpp objects provide those APIs. The resulting Wasm contains lb_800122C8, HSD_ImageDescCopyFromEFB, GXSetTexCopySrc, GXSetTexCopyDst, GXCopyTex, and GXPixModeSync. The old Dolphin GXFrameBuf.c direct GXWGFifo implementation is not compiled into this target. Aurora GXFrameBuffer.cpp writes its custom source, destination, pointer, and BP 0x52 commands into aurora::gx::fifo; the command processor decodes source/destination state and routes the BP 0x52 texture-copy trigger to aurora::gx::copy_tex. That implementation resolves the current render pass into an Aurora texture associated with the exact destination pointer, then exposes that handle by the same pointer during texture binding. On the non-pthreads Emscripten path FIFO processing is inline at publish(), but publish requires an active Aurora frame. GXPixModeSync emits PE state and is not a GPU drain; Aurora GXInvalidateTexAll is empty. No EFB copy was executed or validated here, and these facts do not prove source-pixel output or synchronization correctness.
